title: Atlassian will put OpenAI models deeper into Rovo and its Teamwork Graph
friendlyTitle: Atlassian connects OpenAI models to workplace knowledge
summary: Atlassian and OpenAI have expanded their partnership so GPT-6-family models can power agents across Atlassian’s platform and Rovo. The models will work with Atlassian’s Teamwork Graph, which connects people, projects, documents and decisions; Atlassian also says more than 3,000 of its developers use Codex.
friendlySummary: OpenAI models will work more closely with Rovo and Atlassian’s map of projects, documents, people and decisions. This can help agents understand a team’s real work.
whyItMatters: Enterprise agents become more useful when they can relate Jira work, Confluence documents and organizational decisions rather than answering from a generic prompt. Administrators will need clear permissions and provenance so an agent’s broad context does not expose restricted information or turn stale records into confident recommendations.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An AI assistant is more useful when it has the right company context. Businesses must still control what it can see and show where its answers came from.
